title: Authority Record Reconciliation and Explicit Operator Decision Packet
mode: Read-only reconciliation; no policy adoption; no renderer/runtime execution

authority_assessment.phase_s_scope: Pinned Phase P/Q/R record set only; global_absence_claim=false

semantic.allowed_scope: CHALLENGE_003.target_x, CHALLENGE_005.target_position, CHALLENGE_006.target_position, CHALLENGE_007.target_position semantics for future binding specification only
semantic.excluded_scope: No actual binding, runtime consumer, renderer projection, payload/media, render test, freeze, or release authorization.

region_visibility.allowed_scope: Four candidate fields for future coordinate-policy specification only.
region_visibility.excluded_scope: No coordinate transform, binding, renderer projection, pixel placement, live implementation, or CHALLENGE_008/009 adoption.

coordinate.allowed_scope: Five specific scale/centerline/asset-size/anchor/clipping choices for future consumer specification only.
coordinate.excluded_scope: Runtime transform, binding, projection, renderer activation and pixel placement are false/not approved; rounding and final crop unresolved.

docket.allowed_scope: Preparation docket for R-01 through R-09 only.
docket.excluded_scope: No policy adoption or release authority.

phase_s.allowed_scope: Findings limited to the pinned P/Q/R record set.
phase_s.excluded_scope: Does not establish global absence of authority records.

decisions.policy_question: What deterministic mapping/sampling rule converts source frames to the 30 FPS delivery timeline from the declared source rate?
decisions.evidence_assessment: No authoritative source-to-delivery sampling decision found in the Phase Y review. Runtime test PASS records do not decide sampling policy.
unresolved_requirements: Exact source/delivery timebase and mapping rule
Tie-breaking and boundary behavior
Role/scope/effective date and approval provenance
Acceptance tests and immutable decision record

decisions.policy_question: What exact source-to-delivery spatial mapping policy is adopted for production?
decisions.evidence_assessment: The coordinate record contains narrow choices accepted for future consumer specification only. Phase Y explicitly finds no authorization for runtime transform, binding, projection, or pixel placement; rounding/final crop unresolved.
unresolved_requirements: Explicit broad policy adoption with exact scope
Runtime transform/binding/projection permission separately stated if intended
Pixel rounding and final crop rules
Acceptance obligations and immutable approval provenance

decisions.policy_question: What source fields and presentation semantics are approved for the production visual consumer?
decisions.evidence_assessment: Historical semantics for CHALLENGE_003/005/006/007 are recorded for future binding specification only. They do not approve a binding or production projection.
unresolved_requirements: Exact per-challenge field-to-presentation decision
Separate binding approval with field paths/types and allowed ranges
Consumer projection and acceptance tests
Verifiable approval provenance

decisions.policy_question: Which owner controls visibility and region assignment, and with which precedence rules?
decisions.evidence_assessment: Four field/region/visibility candidates were accepted for future coordinate-policy specification only. No live implementation or binding approval.
unresolved_requirements: Field-level authoritative ownership and precedence
Lifecycle/empty-state/invalid-state behavior
Explicit adoption for production use
Acceptance tests and immutable approval provenance

decisions.policy_question: What exact asset geometry, anchor, crop, clipping and pixel-rounding rules govern output?
decisions.evidence_assessment: Some scale/centerline/asset-size/anchor/clipping choices exist only for future consumer specification. Pixel rounding and final crop remain unresolved.
unresolved_requirements: Final crop and pixel-rounding definitions
Asset-boundary and out-of-range rules
Production consumer scope and explicit adoption
Golden-image/render acceptance obligations and immutable record

decisions.policy_question: What product policy applies to invalid values, missing tracks, inconsistent frames and recovery/fail-closed behavior?
decisions.evidence_assessment: Contracts, validators and tests evidence proposed or implemented behavior; Phase Y found no independent qualifying product-policy authority record.
unresolved_requirements: Named invalid-data cases and exact outcomes
Track continuity and fail-closed/recovery policy
Authority role/scope/effective date and rationale
Acceptance tests, provenance and immutable record

decisions.policy_question: Which component owns each visual semantic and may publish it to the production consumer?
decisions.evidence_assessment: Narrow semantic definitions support future binding specification only. They do not authorize visual consumer bindings or renderer projection.
unresolved_requirements: Per-field producer/consumer ownership contract
Conflict and precedence rules
Explicit production binding/projection scope if intended
Acceptance obligations and verifiable approval record

decisions.policy_question: How should CHALLENGE_008.active_selection be represented and reconciled with declared challenge timing?
decisions.evidence_assessment: Declared duration is 11 seconds while phase durations sum to 12 seconds; active_selection policy remains unresolved. No correction may be inferred.
unresolved_requirements: Authoritative resolution of 11s versus 12s discrepancy
Explicit active_selection representation and ownership
Effective dated approval and source pins
Acceptance tests covering timing and selection

decisions.policy_question: How should CHALLENGE_009.displayed_count be represented and reconciled with declared challenge timing?
decisions.evidence_assessment: Declared duration is 11 seconds while phase durations sum to 12 seconds; displayed_count representation remains unresolved. No correction may be inferred.
unresolved_requirements: Authoritative resolution of 11s versus 12s discrepancy
Explicit displayed_count representation and ownership
Effective dated approval and source pins
Acceptance tests covering count and timing

first_render_prerequisite_note: This phase does not authorize or execute the first render. Before renderer activation, a complete and verifiable authority packet and all required input, seed, binding, render, acceptance, baseline and promotion gates must be approved separately.
